sample.selection_rule: The original six-asset evidence tranche is retained. SOL, AVAX, TRX, XRP, and ADA are added by a pre-outcome screen requiring one-year market coverage, complete free chain-fee history, and primary effective-dated capture evidence; unsupported assets are not substituted based on model results.

H2.claim: Economic activity predicts value more strongly when an active burn or protocol-capture mechanism exists.

scope_design.primary: Pooled eleven-asset panel with fee-by-scope and fee-by-capture interactions; the time-invariant scope main effect is absorbed by asset fixed effects.
sensitivities: Chain-only panel: BTC, ETH, BNB, ARB, SOL, AVAX, TRX, XRP, ADA.
Application-only panel: UNI and AAVE, reported descriptively because two cross-sectional units do not support reliable clustered inference.
Leave-one-asset-out estimates for the pooled and chain-only panels.
Protocol revenue and holder revenue as separate secondary specifications; never substitute them for fees or combine the accounting concepts.
scope_design.pooling_guardrail: A pooled coefficient without the scope indicator and predeclared interactions is inadmissible. Cross-scope differences may reflect measurement units rather than token economics.

models.market_cap: Asset and date fixed-effects panel using lagged log fees, active capture, fee-by-capture, application scope, and fee-by-scope.
models.forward_return: Asset fixed-effects panel using exact seven-day forward returns and the same lagged fee/capture terms; overlapping-return inference must be horizon-robust.
models.secondary: Repeat each model separately for protocol revenue and holder revenue only where the relevant field is observed.

standard_errors.primary: Asset-clustered covariance with wild-cluster-bootstrap p-values reported because the expanded pilot still has only eleven asset clusters.
standard_errors.small_sample_guardrail: All pilot inference remains exploratory; conventional clustered asymptotics are not treated as reliable with only eleven assets.

H2.interpretation: Fees, protocol revenue, and holder revenue remain separate. Chain-level BTC/ETH/BNB/ARB observations and application-level UNI/AAVE observations use explicit scope controls and within-scope sensitivity analysis.

H8.claim: Active and material multi-function assets command a valuation premium.
H8.breadth_rule: Withhold breadth unless all ten VA codes are verified for the asset-date.
H8.withholding_reason: BNB was unresolved when this five-asset pilot was frozen. Its classifications were subsequently resolved, but the original sample is preserved; BNB belongs in a separately versioned six-asset extension.

time_rules.activity_lag: exact calendar t-1; gaps remain null
time_rules.forward_return: log price at exact t+7 minus log price at t; gaps remain null
time_rules.realized_volatility: annualized sample standard deviation of 30 consecutive daily log returns
time_rules.mechanism_state: latest evidenced effective event on or before t; no August-state backfill

estimation_gate: The reviewed eleven-asset H2 specification is frozen after the initial pilot was observed; all H2 estimates remain exploratory rather than confirmatory. The original H8 five-asset pilot is immutable, and newly eligible BNB must enter only a separately versioned six-asset extension. Stablecoin gates belong to a deferred phase.
